description: Create a new load balancer instance. Use dryRun=true to preview without creating.

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without actually creating the load balancer

idleTimeout.description: Idle timeout in seconds (1-3600, default: 60). Cannot be set for NETWORK type

cipherSuiteList.description: List of cipher suites. Only for HTTPS/TLS

protocolTypeCode.description: Listener protocol (HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, UDP, TLS)

targetGroupNo.description: Target group number for default rule

tlsMinVersionTypeCode.description: TLS minimum version (TLSV10, TLSV11, TLSV12, TLSV13). Only for HTTPS/TLS

useHttp2.description: Whether to use HTTP/2 protocol (only for HTTPS listener)

loadBalancerNetworkTypeCode.description: Network type (PUBLIC or PRIVATE). Default: PUBLIC

subnetNoList.description: List of subnet numbers for the load balancer (one LB-only subnet per zone)

throughputTypeCode.description: Throughput type (SMALL, MEDIUM, LARGE, XLARGE for ALB/NProxy; DYNAMIC for NLB)

name: ncloud_create_load_balancer
